entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: An Aerathi berserker from Dominaria who served in the kentsu, first second-in-command, then general.

entities.name: kentsu
entities.description: Elite military in which Hage served.

entities.name: Aerathi
entities.description: Wild and bloodthirsty tribe of Hage.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Assassin who corrupted Hage with black mana.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Warrior who sought vengeance on Overdark and defeated Hage.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Hage was corrupted.

events.summary: Infuriated by Overdark's remark about barbarians in the kentsu, Hage ambushes him; Overdark infuses him with black mana and erases his memory.
events.quote: Overdark infused Hage with black mana, making the berserker his minion

events.summary: Overdark has Hage decapitate General Elsdragon and claim the title.
events.quote: he had Hage decapitate the general and claim the title

events.summary: After a defeat on Argenti, Hage is called back to defend the Imperial Shrine.
events.quote: he was called back to defend the Imperial Shrine in which Overdark was stationed

events.summary: Tetsuo calls down a meteor shower that kills Hage's army, then defeats Hage in battle.
events.quote: Hage and Tetsuo fought a battle in which Tetsuo was victorious.

relations.quote: he had Hage decapitate the general and claim the title
declaring he wanted vengeance on Overdark
